truth.generator: scripts/export-truth.cpp using the unchanged study harness/src/hxio.h quintic Hermite reader

settings.stops: Every 10 s TT, 1 s through eccentric-orbit perigee, and every three-hour UTC weather boundary; accelerations on both sides

sampling.coordinate: Elapsed TT seconds from the fixture epoch

truth.timeHandling: HXSTAT01 epochs and resident PPE TIME_SYSTEM are TT. Interpolation uses two-part TT differences as hx eval does; no TDB/UTC shift is applied to elapsed seconds. The equations use the standard C++ TT-to-TDB conversion internally.

limitations: Synthetic weather; GP sigma is diagnostic only.
Standard/Fast evidence is reused only after matching inputs, artifacts and the reference adapter sources.
T3 integrator settings use the same resident farm export and screen; native truth output/stop scheduling is not substituted.
Synthetic catalog weather; numerical accuracy is not a physical uncertainty claim.
Eight seeds and selected CA events do not establish accuracy for every orbit in the full catalog.
The standard and T3 CA reference were reused only after authenticating unchanged artifacts, inputs, and pipeline.
Artifact instantiation across runtimes is not FFM numerical parity across runtimes.
The separate resident-T3 versus native-T3 diagnostic did not pass its extra-strict 1 mm / 1 micrometer-per-second thresholds; it is not the CA acceptance gate.
CA timings are diagnostic; full-catalog timing is reported separately with host-load observations.

referenceRealizationDiagnostic.purpose: Verify the resident T3 integrator realization against native T3 truth despite different output/stop scheduling.

thresholds.rationale: One thousandth of the CA position gate and SCREEN velocity gate; this checks reference realization, not a change to Fast acceptance.

reentryRegression.discovery: The initial full-catalog candidate emitted one extra hourly trajectory for NORAD 49158; independent standard T3 confirmed a delayed Fast reentry stop. It was not landed.
reentryRegression.correction: Automatic GJ-to-RK handoff near the physical reentry surface, retaining state, exact span clock, and step budget, with a two-second RK step cap. No new mode or flag.
